name: features-stock-option-trades
notes: NEUTRAL TEMPLATE (workflow step `trades`): the option-trade feature table of a stock universe, one row per (entity, entry date), reduced from daily option-trade bars with the TradeBarFeatures node. Placeholders from the step's `in` map: T the entity list, B the underlying bar source (the calendar and closes; same shape as the daily template's, plus the split-ratio role B.fields.split), R the as-traded close derivation (output_field, irregular_field, irregular_tolerance), Q the key field names, O the option-bar stream (store reference, dedup `key_fields`, `fields` naming the stream's entity, date, right, strike, size, price and expiry fields, `call_values`/`put_values` the right field's spellings, `entities` the allow-list applied at intake), F the feature declarations (TradeBarFeatures `fields` map, `moneyness_band`, `strict_prior`, `clock_note`, `presorted`), W work dir, L locations, stream the table's name. CLOCK: TradeBarFeatures defaults to strict_prior, labelling the features of the latest trade date before t with t, so an entry at t never sees t's bars (the daily bar timestamps are session labels and the clock is unproven); F.strict_prior false is accepted only with a written F.clock_note, and then the label is the bar's own date. The label is therefore the ENTRY date, the table is read with a same-day (strict_prior false) keyed match. Trade bars cover only the contracts the stream holds (a DTE window, recorded in the family's `lookback`), not the whole chain. MEMORY: the stream is read lazily (observation-stream: one compact entry per (contract, date) key, never the rows) and reduced as it streams, holding one cell per traded (entity, date, expiry, strike, side) unless F.presorted is true. Output: key fields O.fields.entity and O.fields.date, one column per F.fields output, null where undefined; dates strict mode drops (no later entry in the calendar) are in the run's dropped_dates output. STRIKE BASIS: moneyness and the straddle band compare option strikes (as traded) with the as-traded close rebuilt by AsTradedClose, so they hold across splits; before a spin-off booked as a split (non-whole ratio) the basis is approximate. SPARSITY: the straddle ratio is null when no in-band strike has both a call and a put traded in one expiry (about 8% of rows on the real universe), a property of thin trade data, not an error. SATURDAY BARS: bars labelled on a day outside the underlying calendar (a Saturday, e.g. 2024-06-01) have no later entry date and are dropped in strict mode (listed in dropped_dates).

params.provenance_waiver: each row carries its own entity field; the key check proves no entity appears twice

bars.notes: The underlying closes of every entity: the entry calendar and the moneyness reference.

option_bars.notes: The option-trade bar stream through the onboarding read seam, deduplicated by O.key_fields, projected to O.projection, restricted at intake to the entity list. Lazy: no row list is built.

features.notes: Reduces to one row per (entity, date); the clock rule is in this template's notes. The underlying is the AS-TRADED close (as_traded node), the calendar and the moneyness reference on the strike basis.

params.source: Option-trade-bar features per (entity, entry date), strict-prior clock; read as a keyed table (families.keyed)

table.notes: The hand-off file; refuses to overwrite.

as_traded.notes: Option strikes are AS TRADED, but the bars' closes are split-adjusted at the data's end, so moneyness against them is off by ln(ratio) before a split (and the offset moves when a later split arrives). This node rebuilds the point-in-time as-traded close (close x later split ratios), the strike basis. A spin-off the vendor books as a split (a non-whole ratio) leaves the basis approximate before it: R.irregular_field marks those rows on this node's output; the trade table does not carry the flag.

prices.notes: This entity's bar file through the store.

tagged.notes: Adds the entity field from the foreach key; the empty-when case is the declared catch-all.
